personality_one_liner: A calm, frictionless, and highly legible financial space designed for immediate clarity and zero cognitive overload.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Large touch targets (min 44pt, preferably 56pt for list rows). Intentional empty space to avoid sensory overload for ADHD users.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide immediate financial clarity with zero jargon—showing 'Safe to Spend' and 'HMRC Tax Estimate'.

states.empty: N/A - Dashboard always shows zero states or initial setup cards.
states.error: Readable message 'Could not load your summary' with a retry button.

screens.layout: VStack layout. Top: Large primary widget 'Estimated Take Home' (Income - Expenses - Tax). Below: Horizontal scrolling or stacked customizable cards (HMRC Estimate for current fiscal year, Cash Flow overview). Bottom: 'Quick Add' floating action button or inline large buttons for Invoice/Expense. Use Space Grotesk for big numbers.

screens.name: Invoices
screens.purpose: Manage billed work and generate PDFs.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean desk with text 'No invoices yet. Time to bill!' and a primary 'Create Invoice' CTA.
states.error: Readable message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Standard iOS list layout. Sticky header with total outstanding. List items have a minimum 56pt height, showing Client, Date, Amount, and Status badge (brandTertiary chip). Tapping opens a bottom sheet to view/share PDF.

screens.name: Tax Canvas (HMRC Estimator)
screens.purpose: A dedicated, low-stress screen breaking down the HMRC Self Assessment calculation.
screens.layout: A 'receipt-like' canvas view. Fiscal year selector at the top (Apr 6 - Apr 5). A clean top-to-bottom breakdown: Total Sales -> Less Allowable Expenses -> Taxable Profit -> Estimated Tax (Band + NI). Large export button at bottom (PDF / Copy text).

empty_invoices.alt: A clean, minimalist desk representing an organized workspace

instructions_to_main_agent: ADHD & Accessibility focus: Keep cognitive load extremely low. Use plain English (e.g. 'Money In', not 'Accounts Receivable'). One primary CTA per screen.
Do not use pure white (#FFFFFF) against pure black (#000000). Use the provided soft charcoal and off-white theme tokens to reduce sensory overload.
Typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for body text to ensure maximum legibility. Use Space Grotesk exclusively for large financial numbers, metrics, and data readouts for clear tabular alignment.
Implement iOS-native patterns even on Android, such as smooth bottom sheets (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) for 'Add Expense' and 'Create Invoice' so the user doesn't lose context of where they are.
Tax Canvas layout: Keep it looking like a clear, linear receipt (Gross -> Expenses -> Net -> Tax -> Take Home) rather than a dense dashboard.
Include gradient scrims (bottom 30-40% dark fade) on any full-bleed images to ensure text readability.
